'''Shroomish Forest''' (Japanese: '''キノココの森''' ''{{tt|Kinococo|Shroomish}} Forest'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive [[forest]] in [[Hoenn]]. It is located somewhere between [[Littleroot Town]] and [[Fortree City]]. It was featured in ''[[AG082|A Shroomish Skirmish]]''.

A starving {{TRT}} resorted to stealing some of the {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Shroomish}}'s fruit. The Mushroom Pokémon were incredibly angered by this and went on to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Breloom}}. While {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were enjoying a break, the trio ran into them with the rampaging Breloom closely behind. After the Breloom unleashed a combined {{m|Mach Punch}}, everyone was separated into smaller groups.

[[Max]], {{MTR}}, [[May's Torchic]], and [[Ash's Corphish]] eventually stumbled upon a fruit pile and the Shroomish territory. Another battle ensued, and eventually, everyone was reunited. In an act of defiance, Torchic stood up to a Breloom in a bid to protect Corphish and evolved into {{p|Combusken}} in the process. Combusken then took on the Breloom in a hand-to-hand combat match, which ended in a draw and the two Pokémon came to respect each other.

The area is densely forested, and also features deep ravines and gorges.
